proposals.evidence: This progressive response has intransitive burn + remain: *dvalati through bal-/baḷ-/bar- plus *rahati through rah-/rī-/ry-. Turner gives the remain paradigm across Hindi, Old Marwari and Gujarati. Both lexical constituents are included even where the source writes them together; no separate copula is present in these selected forms.
